facility.name: Little Eagles Child Care
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 501 W TOM LANDRY ST, MISSION, TX, 78572

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: One caregiver was providing care for 5 children ages 3mo-22mo. Age difference between youngest and oldest child exceeds 18 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on the information obtained throughout the course of the investigation; prek classroom was not properly supervised on multiple occasions during times that caregivers needed to step out of the classroom, and a caregiver was observed utilizing a cellphone and sitting - facing away from a group of children during naptime.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface: Diaper changing mat in the infant room is torn.     Note: This was corrected at inspection when provider replaced the changing mat.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §746.3503(a))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: There is a hole on one of the walls of the prek classroom. Four ceiling tiles in the infant room have humidity stains, two of them with visible mold.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Fire Inspection Report, Including Written Approval for Above/Below Ground Level Care: Most recent fire inspection report was not available for review at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Fire Inspection Report, Including Written Approval for Above/Below Ground Level Care (26 TAC §746.801(11))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: One out of six children's files reviewed is missing immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records: Two out four staff training records reviewed are missing certificates for health and safety related trainings.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records (26 TAC §746.801(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records -Training Hours: Six staff files were reviewed. Three files are missing one to 3 certificates for trainings on the topics of Abuse/Neglect, Administering Medications and/or Communicable Diseases.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records -Training Hours (26 TAC §746.901(6))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: Trash can in the boy's restroom and in the toddler room do not have lids. Food residue and a diaper were observed within the trash cans.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: Last fire inspection was completed on 02/08/2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The Children's Products Safety Certification form was last signed on 10/27/2022.     Note: This was corrected at inspection when provider completed and the signed the form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface: Diaper changing mat in the prek is torn and was covered with a cloth material. Diaper changing mat is the infant room has tears.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §746.3503(a))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Four out of six staff records reviewed are missing trainings on the following topics:    -SIDS / Shaken Baby / Early Brain Development  -Food Allergies  -Emergency Prepardness
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Additional Employee Required: There was no additional person in the buiding during naptime.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Additional Employee Required (26 TAC §746.1613(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: 1 of 6 children's files reviewed was missing the child's immunization record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Tracking System: The children's sign in and out sheet was not maintained. A total of 13 children were counted present and only 12 were signed in.      Note: This was CORRECTED during the inspection as the director ensured that all children in care were signed in.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Tracking System (26 TAC §746.801(19))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plans: There was no written activity plan available in the pre-k room. The activity plan posted in the infant room was for the month of May.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plans (26 TAC §746.2203(a))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: Three high chairs were not equipped with safety straps.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup: An infant was observed walking around the room while drinking from a training cup.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup (26 TAC §746.2419(7))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: Two high chairs were missing covers. The wood fence in the outdoor playground had exposed nails withing children's reach.  A tether ball play equipment was  not maintined. The ball did not have air and there was a second piece of rope haging from the pole.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: There were no written feeding instructions available for an infant who was not yet ready for table food.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: Several electrical outlets in the infant room and in the pre-k room did not have a safety cover. This posed a safety hazard for children as the electrical outlets were within children's reach.         Note: This was CORRECTED during the inspection as the electrical outlets were covered with a safety cover.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing Before Eating: A group of children did not wash their hands prior to sitting at a table for lunch time. Hand sanitizer was used instead of soap and water.       Note: This was addressed with the caregiver and children were taken to wash their hands with soap and water prior to eating.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing Before Eating (26 TAC §746.3417(1))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: There was an 18 month different when infants and older children were combined during lunch time. The youngest child in the group was 12 months of age and the oldest child in the group was 3 years of age.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: A caregiver in the pre-k room was heard yelling "Listen sit down" at a child as a form of discipline and also threatened children by telling them they were not getting a price if they did not listen. A caregiver in the infant room was heard yelling "No, you don't push" at an infant.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(6))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants-Hold through 6-months: A caregiver was bottle feeding a 4 month old infant while the infant was laying in a crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants-Hold through 6-months (26 TAC §746.2419(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information: The emergency medical transport and treatment authorization form for two children being transported were missing from the transportation vehicle binder.         Note: This was CORRECTED during the inspection as the required form was obtained and added to the binder.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit: Tweezers were missing from the first-aid kit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §746.4003(a))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures-Soiled Diapers Kept in a Sanitary Manner: A plastic bag containing several soiled diapers was observed hanging from a doorknob in the infant room.           Note: This was CORRECTED during the inspection as a trashcan with a lid was made available and placed next to the diaper changing table.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures-Soiled Diapers Kept in a Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3505(f))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children: A mop bucket containing water was observed in the toddler classroom accessible to children.          Note: This was CORRECTED during the inspection as the bucket and mop were removed from the room and stored out of children's reach.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3701(8))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: A child's file reviewed did not include the most current immunization record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Group Name and Dates: The written activity plans posted in the infant room and pre0k room did not include the dates the plan covered.           Note: This was CORREDTED during the inspection as the dates were included on the written activity plans.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Group Name and Dates (26 TAC §746.2205(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: A caregiver completed training on Standard - First Aid. The training did not include pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name: A list of current employees was not posted.             Note: This was CORRECTED during the inspection as a list of employees was created and posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name (26 TAC §746.401(9))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets: The sheet covering the mattress on a crib and a play yard were observed lose presenting an entanglement hazard. A third play yard assigned to an infant in care did not have a sheet.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Child's Food Allergy Plans: A list of each child s food allergies that require an emergency plan was not posted  in the kitchen or in each room where the child may spend time.        Note: This was CORRECTED during the inspection as a list of a child's food allergies was posted in the kitchen and in each room the child's spends time in.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Child's Food Allergy Plans (26 TAC §746.403(b))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: A food allergy emergency plan was not available for a child enrolled at the center.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)
